main_body: bar stool with round cushioned red seat and metal legs
top_band: pinkish-red and salmon oval seat top surface across rows 2-4
evidence: Rows 2-4 form a foreshortened oval top surface of the stool cushion (light pink/salmon tones), row 5 is the darker red front side of the cushion with a dark crimson bottom rim at row 6, and rows 7-15 show the metal legs and footrest set back beneath the overhanging cushion.

style.evidence: The cushion uses a 4-step red/pink ramp with dark crimson material outlines, and the metal legs use 3-4 grey tones with dark foot pads. For a small single-tile stool, shading and volume are clean and avoid black sticker outlines, though slightly simpler than the larger multi-tile references.
